title: Uniformly most split reliable graphs: a complete answer outside two edge counts
description: Unrefereed AI-assisted mathematical candidate. Existence of uniformly most split reliable graphs is classified outside two edge counts for every n>=7 and completely through n=51 using exact finite certificates. Explicit all-order cone-comparison probability intervals strengthen the boundary reduction, while the intermediate interval and unrestricted-order uniform boundary cases remain unresolved. No external peer review, unaffiliated reproduction, formal verification or exhaustive novelty clearance is established. Original prose/data are CC0-1.0; original code MIT.
